description: Angular component class for GPS geofencing filter configuration in a rule node, managing form controls and validation logic.

classes.name: GpsGeoFilterConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent, handling GPS geofencing filter configuration form.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for GPS geofencing configuration.
